name: Quetiapine
executiveSummary: Atypical antipsychotic. Adult psychosis: titrate **25–50 mg → 300–400 mg/day** (max **750–800 mg**). Bipolar mania/depression: regimens up to **300–800 mg**. Off-label sedation: **25–100 mg** at night — not first-line. XR once daily. Weight gain, sedation, QT.
indications:
## Indications

- Schizophrenia; bipolar mania/depression; adjunct in major depression (labels).

## Precautions

- Orthostatic hypotension at start; marked sedation.
- Metabolic: weight, glucose, lipids. Cataracts (chronic eye checks).
- Dementia: ↑ mortality. Not first-choice chronic hypnotic.

> IR ≠ XR — do not swap mg-for-mg without label.

adulto.dose: Schizophrenia: day 1 **25 mg q12h** → up to **300–400 mg/day** over days. Mania: up to **400–800 mg/day**. Bipolar depression: often **300 mg XR at night**. Elderly: start **12.5–25 mg**.
adulto.administration: PO; XR do not chew, evening preferred.

pediatrico.dose: Adolescents (≥10–13 y by indication): specialist schemes (mania/schizophrenia) — low start.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Somnolence, dry mouth, weight gain, dizziness, constipation; rare: NMS, agranulocytosis, QT.

bibliography.citation: FDA. Quetiapine — labeling and dementia warning.
